originalTitle: Justice department admits reflecting pool damage was not caused by vandals as it moves to drop charges against Olympian – US politics live
summary: US attorney in Washington DC moves to dismiss charges against David Hearn, telling court that documents indicated ‘damage was the result of flawed installation’
content: The US treasury department intervened in ⁠yen exchange ⁠rates on Friday to ⁠support the Japanese currency through outright ⁠purchases, the ‌Financial ‌Times reported. According to the report, citing unnamed sources, the Federal Reserve Bank ‌of New York conducted a sale of euros to buy ⁠yen on behalf of the Department of the Treasury. During a cabinet meeting at Camp David on Friday, the US treasury secretary Scott Bessent carelessly revealed plans for the US to buy $5-$10bn ⁠in Japanese yen in a scribbled ‘to do’ list left visible to a Reuters photographer. The image, taken over Bessent’s shoulder during a portion of the meeting open to journalists, showed a Camp David notepad with the underscored words “To Do” followed by “Buy Japanese Yen (JPY) $5-10 bil.” Bessent’s name card on the Camp David conference table is visible and positioned immediately above the notepad. The ‌photograph was taken at ‌11:33 am local time, Reuters reported. A treasury spokesperson did not immediately respond to a Reuters request ‌for comment on the contents of the notepad, “or whether the Treasury had intervened to help prop up the yen’s value against the dollar on Friday,” the news agency said. Earlier on Friday, about two hours before the note was seen in front of Bessent, Reuters reported that the treasury department had notified a number of banks that ‌it could intervene in the yen market that day, an unnamed source said. Japanese authorities had stepped in to prop up the yen earlier on Friday, triggering a substantial strengthening of the Japanese currency during early trading hours. In a court filing on Friday, the office of the US attorney in Washington DC, Jeanine Pirro, moved to dismiss charges against David Hearn, a former Olympian her office had accused on vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool. In asking to dismiss the criminal indictment, Pirro’s office told the DC Superior Court that “it was not until after the return of the indictment,” that the Department of the Interior “provided additional documents” to prosecutors “indicating that damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in June 2026 was the result of flawed installation by the contractor, Atlantic Industrial Coatings (“AIC”), and the rush to complete the project prior to events associated with the America 250 celebration in the weeks surrounding Independence Day 2026.” “It was not until after these documents were produced,” Pirro’s office added, that her office “first became aware of information showing that the damage was the result of a botched installation and not vandalism as initially represented by DOI.” “The Trump administration’s case against Davey Hearn should never have been brought,” Hearn’s lawyers, Norm Eisen, Mary Dohrmann and Steve Levin said in a statement. “Its dismissal today does not erase the abuse of government power in arresting and charging a patriotic American who did nothing wrong. The government’s approach was ready, fire, aim. The administration owes Mr. Hearn an apology.” The government’s request to dismiss the case against Hearn said that when Pirro inspected the pool on 17 July, “as a defense expert inspected the now-drained Reflecting Pool” that she “immediately noted extensive damage throughout” the pool and requested “all records regarding the installation of the lining.” “These documents indicated a rushed and flawed installation process, with repeated failures of the lining during the installation process, and extensive peeling of the lining throughout the Reflecting Pool,” the filing added. In a social media post sent from Air Force One on Friday afternoon, Donald Trump drew attention to video of tens of thousands of migrants entering the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco the day before. “What’s happening with Spain,” Trump wrote, characterizing the arrival of migrants in the enclave on the North African coast that has been a Spanish possession since 1580 as an invasion, “happened in the United States during the Sleepy Joe Biden Administration, and it will happen again, only worse, if the Dumocrats ever again gain power.” Trump illustrated his warning about the US-Mexico border with video of migrants crossing the border from Morocco into the Spanish territory that Morocco claims as its own, and calls “occupied”. This is not the first time that Trump has sought to sow fear about the US southern border by using video of migrants in Europe. In January 2016, Trump released an ad in support of his first presidential campaign that featured images of migrants surging across a border fence as a narrator promised that Trump would “stop illegal immigration by building a wall on our southern border that Mexico will pay for”. That video, however, was not recorded on the US-Mexico border, but in another Spanish enclave on the Moroccan coast, Melilla, in 2014. Trump’s closing ad for that campaign, released in November 2016 also featured footage of migrants in Europe, passed off as video of immigrants streaming across the border from Mexico into the United States. Near the start of that ad, as the candidate could be heard complaining of “massive illegal immigration,” thousands of people were shown walking along a highway. As I reported in 2016, however, that video was not shot along the southern border of the US — where Trump had promised to build a great wall — but in Hungary, at the height of the 2105 migrant crisis, and it showed Syrian refugees, desperate for safe passage to Germany, marching out of Budapest. chineseTitle: 司法部承认泳池损坏并非人为破坏造成的，并准备撤销对奥林匹亚运动员的指控 – 美国政治直播
chineseSummary: 华盛顿特区的美国检察官提出驳回对大卫·赫恩的指控，他告诉法庭，文件显示“损坏是由于安装缺陷造成的”
chineseContent: 据《金融时报》报道，美国财政部周五干预日元汇率，通过直接购买支持日元。报道援引未透露姓名的消息人士的话称，纽约联邦储备银行代表财政部出售欧元以购买日元。周五在戴维营举行的内阁会议上，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特漫不经心地透露了美国购买 5 至 100 亿美元日元的计划，这份计划的内容是一份潦草的“待办事项”清单，而路透社的摄影师可以看到这份清单。这张照片是贝森特在向记者开放的会议期间从肩膀上拍摄的，照片中显示了一个戴维营记事本，上面有下划线的“待办事项”字样，后面是“买入 5-100 亿美元日元”。戴维营会议桌上的贝森特名片清晰可见，位于记事本上方。据路透社报道，这张照片拍摄于当地时间上午 11:33。该通讯社表示，财政部发言人没有立即回应路透社对记事本内容发表评论的请求，“或者财政部是否在周五进行了干预以帮助支撑日元兑美元的价值”。周五早些时候，一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士称，就在贝森特面前看到这张纸条前大约两个小时，路透社报道称，财政部已通知多家银行，当天可能会干预日元市场。日本当局周五早些时候介入支撑日元，引发日元在早盘交易时段大幅走强。在周五提交的一份法庭文件中，美国华盛顿特区检察官办公室珍妮·皮罗 (Jeanine Pirro) 提出驳回对前奥运选手大卫·赫恩 (David Hearn) 的指控，该办公室指控大卫·赫恩 (David Hearn) 破坏了林肯号发动机。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
